目蓋は怯えるように震えているのに、ナイフから逃れようとしない。

pages.en:
I bring the knife down.

…Sakura does not move.

Her eyelids tremble as if in fear, yet she makes no attempt to escape the blade.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I bring the knife down.
…Sakura doesn’t move.
Her eyelids are shaking in fear, but she doesn’t try to move away.

pages.en:
“————”

I bring the keen silver arc down upon the white throat.

It bites deep, splitting the flesh wide.

Has a fire broken out?

The red that erupts suggests an explosion more than the jet of a fire hose.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
I drop the sharp silver blade onto her white neck.
It slices it right open.
Is there a fire?
The red blood sharply splatters against the wall like a fire hose.
The spray of red is more like an explosion than a hose.

、あ」
膝から落ちた。
……ひゅうひゅうと音がする。
桜からではなく、俺の喉元から、びしゃびしゃと音がする。
pages.jaRuby:

、あ」

pages.en:
“H—ah.”

My knees give way.

…A thin wheezing fills the room.

It does not come from Sakura. The wet, splashing sound bubbles from my own throat.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Haah.”
I drop to my knees.
…I hear wheezing sounds.
The splashing noise is coming not from Sakura’s throat, but from my own.

pages.ja:
……そうか。
桜が死を受け入れても、彼女がそれを許さない。
俺は、無防備な桜に刃を落とそうとし、
彼女は、桜以上に無防備な俺に、短剣を振るったのだ。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
…I see.

Sakura may accept death, but she will not permit it.

I tried to bring my blade down on defenseless Sakura—

and she swung her dagger at me, more defenseless still.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…I see.
Even if Sakura has accepted her death, she won’t allow it.
I tried to use the knife against the defenseless Sakura,
and she attacked with her dagger, because I was even more defenseless.

pages.ja:
「…………………………」
苦しくはない。
むしろ楽になれた気さえする。
……だが、最期に悔いは残り続けた。
俺が退場したあと。
誰が、桜の罪を、贖ってやれるのだろうか、と。
pages.jaRuby:

誰が、桜の罪を、[ruby text=あがな]贖ってやれるのだろうか、と。
pages.en:
“…………………………”

I am not suffering.

If anything, I almost feel relieved.

…But one regret remains with me to the end.

After I make my exit—

who will atone for Sakura's sins on her behalf?
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…………”
I don’t feel any pain.
Rather, I feel relieved.
…But regret remains
like the bloodstain.
in my final moment.
After I exit the stage…
Who will atone for Sakura’s sin?
